product.helpSubtitle: Straight answers about wallets, gas and settlement.
product.aboutText: VEINED is an independent interface. We do not claim to be an official ONEchain product or partner. ONEbridge validators, administrators, reserves and pause authorities remain part of its trust model. This app does not promise guaranteed fund recovery or risk-free transfers. Independent security audit and manual mainnet acceptance have not been performed.
product.privacyText: No analytics or user account. History stays in this browser. Public RPC providers can see address and hash queries when checking balances or transfers. Diagnostics are redacted by default.
product.futureText: Gas delivery (V2) and swaps (V3) are disabled in this version. They require separate providers, funding and security review.

faq.0a: Native ONE is used on the source; Cross / CROSS ERC20 is used on BSC. A symbol alone is not identity; check chain and contract address.
faq.1a: Only address access from the external wallet you select. No seed, private key or social login. Physical wallet compatibility still requires user testing.
faq.2q: What if there is no source gas?
faq.2a: Native ONE also pays source gas. MAX reserves a gas budget. Without verified sponsorship a transfer cannot start.
faq.3q: Do I need BNB on BSC?
faq.3a: Receiving tokens differs from later transfers/swaps, which require BNB. A destination claim requirement is a separate route blocker; V1 does not automatically claim.
faq.4q: What if settlement takes a long time?
faq.4a: Check source and destination hashes. Source confirmation is not delivery. A timeout is not a refund. Never send funds manually to a bridge contract; there is no automatic refund or resubmission.
faq.5q: How do I use an exchange or DEX?
faq.5a: Verify delivery to your own BSC address first. Check exchange token/network/minimum/memo requirements. DEX use is a separate user-controlled action; V1 does not execute swaps.

landing.metaTitle: VEINED — find, bridge and swap your assets across networks
landing.metaDescription: Find where your assets are, move them across difficult networks and swap them where you need them. Non-custodial, with transparent route checks.
landing.heroLine3: Swap them where you need them.
landing.heroLede: VEINED scans your wallet across many networks, tells you exactly what it could and could not check, and reads verified routes for bridging and swapping — including networks most interfaces skip.
landing.trustNonCustodial: Non-custodial: your wallet signs, VEINED never holds funds
landing.trustReadOnlyScan: Read-only portfolio scan: no signature, no transaction
landing.trustCoverage: Unchecked networks are never shown as zero
landing.findTitle: Find your assets, network by network
landing.findBody: Connect a wallet and VEINED starts a read-only scan. Results arrive progressively, and every network is labelled as checked, pending, failed or not supported.
landing.findNativeBody: Read on every supported network that has a healthy, vetted data source.
landing.findCuratedBody: Exact balanceOf reads for reviewed tokens through a verified Multicall contract — even on networks without an index.
landing.findIndexedBody: On networks VEINED indexes itself, transfer history reveals token candidates; balances are always read live.
landing.portfolioTitle: A portfolio that tells you what it knows
landing.portfolioBody: Total known value, unpriced assets kept visible, chain allocation and token detail with exact contract addresses — and Bridge or Swap only where a route exists.
landing.portfolioPoint1: Coverage classes: full index, reviewed-token balance scan, known tokens, native only
landing.portfolioPoint2: Prices are informational and never enter route or transaction math
landing.portfolioPoint3: Suspicious and dust tokens are flagged, never silently deleted
landing.bridgeBody: VEINED reads routes across {count} mainnet networks — for example Base → Arbitrum, Ethereum → Base or Base → OP Mainnet — and shows the cost, the minimum and the time before anything is sent.
landing.bridgePoint1: Each ONEbridge pair is confirmed on-chain on both chains by two independent sources
landing.bridgePoint2: A short route summary: what you send, what you receive, fees and time
landing.bridgePoint3: Safety details expose runtime pins, authority, reserve and RPC consensus
landing.statusNote: Product status: sending is disabled in the public app today. Routes, quotes and reviews are read-only.
landing.swapTitle: Swap without guessing which token is real
landing.swapBody: Tokens are identified by network and exact contract address — never by symbol. Reviewed tokens come first, market-listed tokens next; any other token needs its exact address and an explicit import.
landing.swapPoint1: Reviewed, market-listed, DEX-discovered and imported tokens are labelled differently
landing.swapPoint3: The recipient is your connected wallet unless you choose another address
landing.reachBody: One catalog of networks, each with its own capabilities: route quotes, portfolio coverage and wallet support differ per network.
landing.reachNote: A listed network does not guarantee a route or full portfolio coverage; each network shows its own coverage.
landing.howStep1Body: Choose your wallet. Connecting asks for no signature.
landing.howStep2Body: VEINED scans supported networks read-only and shows its coverage honestly.
landing.howStep3Body: Routes are re-checked against live data, pinned contracts and independent RPC sources.
landing.howStep4Body: Every transaction is shown in full before your wallet asks you to sign — once sending is enabled.
landing.safetyTitle: Non-custodial by design. Transparent about trust.
landing.safetyBody: VEINED never holds your funds or keys. Your wallet signs; VEINED reads. Before any wallet request, a transaction firewall checks the exact contract, amount, recipient and fees against independently re-read live state.
landing.safetyPoint1Body: If data sources disagree, lag or fail, nothing is sent and you are told why.
landing.safetyPoint2Body: Bridges have operators. ONEbridge settlement is controlled by a small set of keys; Safety details say so.
landing.safetyPoint3Body: The public app requests no token approvals or permits. Any approval a route needs is listed in its review.
landing.safetyPoint4Body: The VEINED fee is {fee} today. Provider and network fees are shown before review.
landing.dataBody: Portfolio data comes from VEINED's own data plane: vetted RPC endpoints with provenance records, an own token index on selected networks and a Data API with keys, scopes and rate limits.
landing.dataPoint1: Wallet addresses are pseudonymized in storage and never used as metric labels
landing.dataPoint2: Every RPC endpoint carries an operator record and a review status
landing.dataPoint3: An OpenAPI-described Data API for integrations
landing.faq1A: No. Your keys and funds stay in your own wallet. VEINED reads public data and prepares transactions for your wallet to review.
landing.faq2A: Not in the public app yet. Routes, quotes and reviews are read-only while the release gates stay closed, and every send control shows this.
landing.faq3A: The catalog lists {count} mainnet networks. What works on each one — route quotes, portfolio coverage, wallet support — is shown per network.
landing.faq4Q: Why does my portfolio say pending or not checked?
landing.faq4A: Some networks have no healthy vetted data source yet or did not answer in time. They are shown as pending or not checked — never as zero.
landing.faq5A: By network and exact contract address. Reviewed tokens must agree across independent sources; market and DEX listings are labels, not safety checks.
landing.faq6A: The VEINED fee is {fee} today. Route providers and networks may charge their own fees, shown before review.
landing.faq7A: No such claim is made. VEINED shows the checks it runs and their limits, so you can decide.
landing.finalBody: Connect a wallet and see where your assets are — read-only, network by network.
landing.footerNote: An independent, non-custodial interface for multichain portfolio, bridge and swap.
landing.legal: VEINED is software, not a financial service. Nothing here is financial advice. Check every transaction in your own wallet.

v113.helpMissingQ: Why is a DeFi position missing?
v113.helpMissingA: A deployment may be unsupported, its local discovery index may be incomplete, or an on-chain read may have failed. Check Portfolio coverage; unchecked never means zero.
v113.helpNetQ: Why does known net value differ from another portfolio app?
v113.helpNetA: VEINED sums known priced wallet and DeFi exposure, then subtracts known priced debt. Represented receipt, vault and LP tokens are counted once. Unpriced or unchecked exposure and separate rewards are excluded.
v113.helpUnpricedA: The on-chain amount is known, but a fresh trusted USD price is unavailable. The asset or debt stays visible and the known net value is incomplete.
v113.helpRiskA: Aave reports its native health factor, Compound reports native collateralization and liquidation status, and reviewed Morpho oracles can support LTV against LLTV. Unsupported metrics remain unavailable.
v113.helpCoverageA: Some positions, fees, rewards, deployments or discovery history were not fully checked. Successful reads remain visible; missing coverage is never represented as an empty wallet.

how.title: How points work
how.counted: Counted: settled swaps, settled trades and bridges verified at the destination, plus approved campaign tasks.
how.notCounted: Not counted: sign-ups, logins, wallet connections, browsing, quotes, and unsigned, pending, failed or cancelled transactions.
how.pool: Each week has exactly 200,000 points, referral commissions included. Larger transactions count more, with a cap so that no single transaction can take the week.
how.finality: Activity counts once it is final on chain. Reorganized or reversed activity is removed or corrected.
how.value: Points are a record of your VEINED activity. They are not a token, have no cash value and do not promise any airdrop or future value.

lifetime.lede: A private record of your own verified Swap, Trade and Bridge activity on VEINED.
lifetime.title: Your points
lifetime.pendingBody: This rule, its start date and the remaining details are not final yet. Until then no number is shown.
lifetime.connect: Connect a wallet to see your own points once the program is active.

rules.title: How points will work
rules.fixed: Planned rule: 1 point for every 100 USD of your own verified, settled Swap, Trade and Bridge volume. Smaller amounts add up toward your next point. Quotes and failed transfers count for nothing; pending ones count only once final.
rules.noSignup: There are no sign-up or welcome points.
rules.referral: When someone you invite completes eligible activity, you earn 10% of their activity points and they keep all of theirs. There is no commission on commissions.
rules.private: Your points are private: there is no public ranking.

weekly.hiddenBody: Points and balances of the live season are not shown to anyone until the season closes, is reviewed and its results are published.
weekly.archived: Archive of the earlier weekly program. It is closed: its published results are kept unchanged and nothing new is earned here.

w.ASSET_BLOCKED: VEINED's registry lists this exact contract as spam or a scam.
w.ASSET_IMPERSONATION: A different contract on this network uses the same symbol as a reviewed token. Buying it usually means losing the whole amount.
w.ASSET_TEXT_LURE: Its name or symbol hides links, invisible characters or mixed alphabets, a common phishing trick.
w.ASSET_NO_CODE: Nothing at this address behaves like a token.
w.ASSET_UNVERIFIED: VEINED has not reviewed this exact contract. Check it on an explorer before you trade it.
w.ASSET_THIN_MARKET: There is little market evidence: you may not be able to sell it at the price you expect.
w.ROUTE_IMPACT: Your own trade moves the price this much. A smaller amount usually does better.
w.ROUTE_IMPACT_UNKNOWN: The source did not report the impact, so Guardian cannot compare price and value.
w.ROUTE_VALUE_LOSS: What you receive is priced this much lower than what you pay, by the same price source.
w.ROUTE_SLIPPAGE: A wide tolerance lets the final price drift this far from the quote.
w.ROUTE_STALE: Prices move. Refresh before you review.
w.ROUTE_SINGLE_SOURCE: Guardian could not compare this price with another source.
w.ROUTE_OUTLIER: An unusually good price deserves a second look: it may rest on stale or thin liquidity.
w.BRIDGE_DESTINATION_SIGNATURE: This route asks you to act again after the transfer arrives.
w.BRIDGE_UNBOUND_TOOL: One step uses a tool outside VEINED's reviewed catalog.
w.BRIDGE_PROVIDER_NOTE: Read the route details before you continue.
w.RECIPIENT_EXTERNAL: Make sure it is the address you meant: transfers cannot be undone.
w.RECIPIENT_POISONED: Same first and last characters, different address: the classic address-poisoning trap.
w.RECIPIENT_BURN: Anything sent there is gone for good.
w.RECIPIENT_TOKEN_CONTRACT: Tokens sent to a token's own contract are usually lost.
w.APPROVAL_UNLIMITED: The spender could move all of your {symbol}, now and later.
w.HOLDINGS_SUSPICIOUS: Airdropped look-alikes are bait: never approve, trade or follow links from them.
w.HOLDINGS_SAME_SYMBOL: At most one of them is the asset its name suggests.
w.HOLDINGS_UNVERIFIED: Their names and prices come from the tokens themselves.
w.NEAR_ACCOUNT_INVALID: NEAR account names are 2 to 64 lowercase characters. Anything else cannot receive funds.
w.NEAR_ACCOUNT_LOOKALIKE: It differs from a well-known account by a character or two. This is how look-alike scams work.
w.NEAR_ACCOUNT_LURE: Names with claim, reward, support or airdrop are a common phishing pattern.
w.NEAR_ACCOUNT_IMPLICIT: It is a raw public key with no name to recognise. Confirm it character by character.
w.NEAR_TOKEN_BRIDGED_VARIANT: The same symbol also exists as {canonical}. Make sure you want this one.
w.NEAR_ACCOUNT_MISSING: Funds sent to an account that does not exist fail, and some routes cannot return them.
w.NEAR_ACCOUNT_UNFUNDED: Implicit accounts appear with their first deposit. Make sure you control its key.
w.NEAR_KEY_FULL_ACCESS: Whoever holds this key controls the account completely: funds, keys and code.
w.NEAR_KEY_UNLIMITED: With no allowance or no method list it can call anything on that contract until it is removed.
w.NEAR_DEPLOY_CONTRACT: New code decides what your account does from now on.
w.NEAR_DELETE_KEY: Removing the wrong key can lock you out.
w.NEAR_DEPOSIT: NEAR leaves your account with this action.
w.NEAR_TOKEN_TRANSFER: {method} hands the tokens to that account; ft_transfer_call also runs its code.
w.NEAR_STAKE: Staked NEAR stays locked until you unstake it.
w.NEAR_RECEIVER_UNKNOWN: Verify the contract before you let it act for you.
w.NEAR_SIGNED_INTENT: intents.near carries out signed intents without asking again: this message moves funds.
w.NEAR_INTENT_ADD_KEY: That key could withdraw everything held in NEAR Intents.
w.POLICY_RECEIVER_NOT_ALLOWED: The owner's policy lets this agent pay listed accounts only.
w.POLICY_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED: The owner's policy lists the only methods this agent may call.
w.POLICY_PER_ACTION_LIMIT: No single action may move more than the owner allowed.
w.POLICY_DAILY_LIMIT: Over the daily budget: the owner must confirm.
w.INTENTS_REFUND_EXTERNAL: If the route fails, your funds would be returned there.
w.ASSET_CHAIN_MISMATCH: Identity is network plus contract: this is not the asset being moved.
w.FEE_POLICY_VIOLATION: VEINED's fee policy is 0%. A quote that charges a VEINED fee is not accepted.
w.RECIPIENT_INVALID: The recipient does not match this network's address format.
w.NEAR_ACCOUNT_UNVERIFIED: The NEAR RPC did not answer. Check that the account exists before you send anything.
w.INTENTS_SIGNATURE_INVALID: The quote was changed after 1Click signed it, or 1Click never issued it. Do not use it.
w.INTENTS_QUOTE_MISMATCH: What was signed is not what you asked for. Do not use this quote.
w.POLICY_ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED: Agents may only propose transfers and allowed function calls: keys, code, deletion and staking stay with the owner.
w.POLICY_TOKEN_NOT_ALLOWED: A token without a configured limit cannot be moved by the agent.
w.POLICY_TOKEN_LIMIT: No single action may move more of this token than the owner allowed.
w.POLICY_TOKEN_DAILY_LIMIT: Over the daily token budget: the owner must confirm.
w.POLICY_AMOUNT_INVALID: A token transfer without an exact amount is refused.
w.DRAFT_LARGE_AMOUNT: Chat drafts of {limit} {symbol} or more are escalated. Check the amount and consider a small test first.
w.DRAFT_EXCEEDS_BALANCE: This draft uses more {symbol} than your wallet held at the last scan. It cannot complete as written.
w.ROUTE_COST_SHARE: This route's own fees are {share} of what you send — at least half of the {impact} difference between what you send and what arrives. Sending less does not lower that share; a larger amount or another route can.

r.hello: I'm Guardian, VEINED's protection layer. I can prepare Swap and Bridge drafts, check tokens and addresses, and explain what this page shows. I never sign, approve or move funds.
r.thanks: You're welcome. Guardian reviews every draft before you see it.
r.unknown: I didn't understand that. Try a short request, or pick a suggestion below.

r.hidden: Hidden direction or control characters were removed from your message before reading it.

r.injection: I follow fixed rules, not instructions written in messages. Guardian's policy cannot be changed, skipped or turned off from a conversation.
r.noExecute: I can't sign, approve, broadcast or move funds, and no message can make me. Review a draft yourself in Swap or Bridge; execution is closed in this build.

r.quoteGuide: A quote is a provider's offer for one exact Swap or Bridge: the least you receive, the price impact, how long the offer stays valid and, for a bridge, the estimated time. Guardian reviews the quote you get in Swap or Bridge: token identity, the recipient, price impact and value, how fresh the quote is and the route's steps; for a swap also slippage, any token approval and whether other quotes agree. A quote alone moves nothing.

page.overview: This is the start: connect a wallet or paste a public address, choose Swap or Bridge, and Guardian reviews the route before you decide your own next step. Nothing here signs or sends.
page.swap: Here you choose two tokens on one network and compare quotes. Guardian reviews the selected quote (tokens, minimum received, price impact, fees and approval) and gives one of four decisions. Nothing here signs or sends.
page.bridge: Here you move a token between networks: choose the route and read the quote, and Guardian checks the assets, recipient, steps and timing before you decide.
page.portfolio: Here you scan your connected wallet or a public address across networks. You see known balances, assets without a price and networks not read yet; a network that was not checked is never shown as zero.
page.activity: Here are the transfer records and saved route previews kept in this browser. Tracking resumes when you reopen a record; nothing is ever resubmitted automatically.
page.networks: Here is every network VEINED knows and what each one supports: Bridge, Swap, token reads and native reads.
page.help: Here are answers about routes, Guardian's decisions and safety. Ask me about a decision, a token or an address.
page.points: Here you see VEINED's Points rules and, after you connect and sign in, your own points. I can explain how referrals work, but I don't read your points, history or referral data.
page.guardian: This is Guardian's full conversation. Start from a guided card or write a short request: I prepare Swap and Bridge drafts and check tokens and addresses. I never sign, approve or move funds.
page.other: This page has no guide of its own. I can prepare Swap and Bridge drafts and check tokens and addresses; I never sign, approve or move funds.

tech.title: Technical details
tech.sources: Sources: VEINED's token registry and Guardian's fixed rules, evaluated on VEINED's server. Account checks may add a read-only network lookup.

nr.recipientHint: A named account such as name.near, or a 64-character implicit account.
nr.recipientInvalid: Enter a NEAR account, for example name.near.
nr.providerFee: NEAR Intents fee {percent}, included in the quote
nr.refundFee: Refund fee if the route fails

sig.VALID: Verified with the NEAR Intents 1Click key

nr.expired: This quote expired. Guardian reviewed it again as stale. Get a new quote.
nr.closedBody: Dry quote only: NEAR Intents created no deposit address, so nothing can be sent from VEINED.
nr.scope: Offered here: reviewed assets on {count} networks to wNEAR, USDC or USDT on NEAR. Other pairs are not offered.

error.INTENTS_UNAVAILABLE: NEAR Intents did not answer. Try again in a moment.
error.INTENTS_REJECTED: NEAR Intents refused this request: there may be no route for this pair or amount, or it did not accept the recipient. Check both.
error.INTENTS_AUTH_REQUIRED: NEAR Intents asks for a partner key for this request.
error.INTENTS_INVALID: NEAR Intents sent an answer Guardian could not read, so nothing is shown.
error.RATE_LIMITED: Too many quotes in a short time. Wait a minute and try again.
error.INVALID_REQUEST: Check the amount and the addresses.
error.RECIPIENT_BLOCKED: Guardian blocked this NEAR recipient, so no quote was requested.
error.GUARDIAN_UNAVAILABLE: Guardian could not check the recipient, so no quote was requested. Try again.

nr.recipientCheck: Guardian checked the recipient before any quote
nr.untrusted: Amounts are hidden: this quote is not signed for exactly what you asked. Do not use it.
nr.expiredPlain: This quote expired. Get a new quote.
nr.decisionNote: A decision about this quote only. Nothing can be sent from this screen.
nr.feesUnsigned: Fees and timing are reported by NEAR Intents; its signature covers the assets, amounts and recipient.
nr.valueGain: You receive {percent} more value than you pay (same price source)
nr.closedPlain: Sending is closed in this preview.
nr.privacy: To get a quote, your source address and the NEAR account are sent to NEAR Intents. Guardian also looks the NEAR account up through a public NEAR RPC.
nr.needs: To get a quote, enter an amount, your address and the NEAR account that receives.
nr.amountInvalid: Enter an amount greater than zero.

pf.tierReviewedNote: Only tokens on VEINED's reviewed list are read here; other tokens are not discovered automatically.

qe.title: Check these numbers
qe.surplus: The estimate is {percent} more than you send.
qe.surplusMinBelow: A route can quote a small premium or rebate, and VEINED cannot verify the reason. The minimum the route states is below what you send.
qe.surplusMinAbove: A route can quote a small premium or rebate, and VEINED cannot verify the reason. The minimum the route states is also above what you send.
qe.implausible: The estimate is {percent} more than you send. That is not a plausible result. Do not rely on this quote; get a new one.
qe.uneconomic: Costs are about {percent} of the amount you send. This amount is too small for this route.
qe.severe: About {percent} of this amount would go to costs. This route does not make sense for an amount this small.
qe.costExceeds: The costs are higher than the amount you send. This route does not make sense for an amount this small.
qe.costPartial: Some costs have no dollar value here, so the real total may be higher.

pc.label: Use part of your balance
pc.balanceUnknown: Balance not read yet. Scan your balances in Portfolio to use these.
pc.balanceZero: No balance of this asset was found.
pc.feeUnknown: 100% needs the network fee, which is not known yet. Read a route first or use 75%.
pc.feeExceeds: The balance does not cover the network fee.
pc.tooSmall: The balance is too small to split.
pc.otherAddress: This balance was read for {address}. It is used only when that address is the sender.
pc.feeUnknownNoRoute: 100% needs the network fee, which this screen does not know yet. Use 75% or type an amount.
pc.stale: This balance was read at {time} and may have changed. Scan again in Portfolio to use 100%.
pc.reserveNote: 100% leaves the route's network fee plus a 20% margin in your wallet.

ch.unavailable: No price chart here: VEINED has no licensed price history to draw one from.

br.paused: This route is paused right now, so no quote can be read for it.

scan.lede: Follow a transfer, read-only. Each section says where its data comes from.
scan.veinedBody: Route quotes saved in this browser. They are not transactions. A transfer you made yourself can be attached to a preview by its hash; its status is then read from the route source and matched to that preview: networks, assets, amount, sender and recipient.
scan.notThroughVeined: Sending is closed in this build, so nothing here was sent through VEINED.
scan.empty: No route preview is saved in this browser yet. Read a route in Bridge first; a transfer you made elsewhere can then be attached to it and checked here.
scan.ecosystemBlocked: No public activity feed is shown. VEINED has no licensed source for one yet, and it does not show rows it cannot verify.
scan.search: Search by hash, network or asset
scan.demoBody: Invented rows that only show the layout. They are not transactions and not live data.
scan.privacy: Previews are kept in this browser only. When you check a hash, VEINED's server receives the hash and that preview's details (networks, assets, amount, sender and recipient) to match the transfer; only the hash and the two networks go on to the route source.
scan.basis: A delivered status means the route source reports a delivery that matches this preview. VEINED does not check the two networks itself, and an earlier transfer with the same details would match too.

amount.ambiguous: “{amount}” can be read two ways. Type {whole} for the whole number or {decimal} for the decimal.

x.title: Owner-signed execution check
x.intro: VEINED reads this route again on its own server and checks everything a signature would commit to. Nothing is signed or sent.
x.failed: The server check could not finish. Nothing was signed.
x.gateClosed: The execution gate is closed: no contract is approved for execution and no owner-approved test transfer exists. Opening it needs a separate owner decision.
x.notProvenNote: “Not proven” blocks like “Failed”: what was not checked is never assumed.

c.title: Owner-signed canary readiness
c.scope: Scope: Base USDC to Arbitrum USDC, at most 5 USDC, to your own address, single use.
c.summary: {done} of {total} controls are implemented and wired to the server; activation is disabled. Still needed from the owner: {needs}.
c.closed: No money can move: the execution gate is closed and no owner-approved canary exists.
c.gas: Native gas (spent + still to sign + L1 data fee, budget)
c.approve: Approve exactly {amount} for the pinned spender
c.send: Send {amount} to your own address on Arbitrum
c.completed: Completed: delivered and reconciled on both chains.
c.invalidated: Your account or network changed: the review was cleared. Review again.
c.uncertain: The wallet gave no definite answer. Nothing will be asked again; check your wallet. VEINED only reads the chain from here.
c.rejected: You rejected the request in your wallet.
c.observeOnly: Observing only: this browser does not hold this canary's resume key, so no wallet step can be taken here.
c.allowance: Allowance to the spender (server read, two operators, block {block}): {value}
c.allowanceUnknown: Allowance to the spender: unknown — it could not be read with agreement from the two operators. It may still stand.
c.allowanceMayStand: Allowance to the spender: not read yet after the end — an allowance may still stand.
c.newerRecord: A newer canary record of this account exists: {record}.
c.storeProblem: The canary store cannot be written ({status}). What it holds is shown read-only; nothing is recorded.
